Name: Mouse For Farmhand(Assign the mouse in split-screen)
Author: neoiw
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Mouse For Farmhand[/b][/size]
[size=4]Give the physical mouse to a local split-screen farmhand.[/size][/center]

[b]What it does[/b]

Stardew Valley normally assigns mouse input to the host in local split-screen. Mouse For Farmhand lets you assign that physical mouse to another local player instead. The host and other non-target players keep their gamepad-controlled menu cursor.

This is useful when a farmhand handles decorating or uses mouse-focused interfaces such as Happy Home Designer, while the host prefers a controller.

[b]Features[/b]

[list]
[*]Assign mouse position, clicks, and wheel input to players 1-4.[/*]
[*]Player 2, the first farmhand, is selected by default.[/*]
[*]The selected farmhand can switch automatically between mouse and gamepad menu control.[/*]
[*]Prevent the physical mouse from affecting other local players.[/*]
[*]Preserve gamepad menu navigation for the host and other players.[/*]
[*]Optional Generic Mod Config Menu integration.[/*]
[*]English and Simplified Chinese included.[/*]
[*]No save data changes; safe to remove.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Requirements[/b]

[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 or later[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0 or later[/*]
[*]Local split-screen multiplayer[/*]
[/list]
Generic Mod Config Menu is optional. Happy Home Designer is a supported use case, not a required dependency.

[b]Installation[/b]

[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Extract the MouseForFarmhand folder into your Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Start the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Configuration[/b]

Install Generic Mod Config Menu and select the mouse player from the title screen, or close the game and edit config.json. Player 1 is the host; player 2 is the first farmhand. The target can be changed while playing; the transfer applies after all physical mouse buttons are released.

[b]Compatibility and limitations[/b]

Most menus and mods that use Stardew Valley's normal input system should follow the assignment. A mod that reads the physical mouse directly may bypass it. Keyboard behavior is unchanged, and only one physical mouse can be assigned at a time.

[b]Tested environment[/b]

Stardew Valley 1.6.15, SMAPI 4.5.2, Windows local split-screen, and Happy Home Designer 2.5.4.

[line]

[b]中文说明[/b]

《星露谷物语》本地同屏模式默认由主账号接收鼠标输入。本模组可以把实体鼠标分配给其他本地玩家，同时保留主账号和其他玩家的手柄菜单控制。

它适合由副账号负责装修、使用 Happy Home Designer 等鼠标界面，而主账号使用手柄游玩的场景。

[b]主要功能[/b]

[list]
[*]可将鼠标位置、点击与滚轮输入分配给玩家 1-4。[/*]
[*]默认分配给玩家 2，也就是副账号 1。[/*]
[*]目标副账号可在鼠标与手柄菜单操作之间自动切换。[/*]
[*]实体鼠标不会干扰其他本地玩家。[/*]
[*]主账号及其他玩家仍可用手柄操作菜单。[/*]
[*]可选支持 Generic Mod Config Menu。[/*]
[*]内置简体中文与英文。[/*]
[*]不修改存档数据，可以安全移除。[/*]
[/list]
[b]安装与配置[/b]

安装 SMAPI 后，将 MouseForFarmhand 文件夹解压到 Mods 文件夹。安装 GMCM 后可在标题界面或游戏运行中选择鼠标玩家；也可以关闭游戏后编辑 config.json。玩家 1 是主账号，玩家 2 是副账号 1。

[b]限制[/b]

绕过游戏输入系统、直接读取实体鼠标的模组可能不会遵循鼠标分配。键盘输入不会被修改，一次只能分配一个实体鼠标。
